jobs.description:
Company description:
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 
 
 
 
 
Job description: Are you ready to take your next step within the Volvo Group? Financial Control & Accounting TTI (Trucks Technology & Industrial Division) is looking for a Chief Accountant to strengthen our team.
  
 Financial Control & Accounting (FCA) is a global finance organization in Group Finance responsible for securing finance and tax compliance, accounting and financial reporting for most Divisions, Business Areas and Group Functions in Volvo Group. FCA also hosts our Finance Global Delivery Center providing qualitative, process efficient, automated finance deliveries. We are a truly global organization with around 1400 highly professional colleagues in more than 50 countries, closely integrated with local business operations.
  
 Our mission is to secure accurate and timely financial reporting and compliance with the Volvo Group. We aspire to lead finance and compliance through excellence and innovation.
 What you will do 
 
 As Chief Accountant, you will lead and coordinate the end-to-end monthly closing and accounting process for Volvo Parts, handling the accounting of the TTI value chain Service Operation and Technology (SOT). This is done in close collaboration with Global Competence Centre (GCC) Finance, TTI SOT Business Control, Tax, Payroll & Pensions and Group Accounting. You will be accountable for accurate, efficient and compliant financial reporting for TTI SOT legal accounting, contribute to driving improvements and you will also represent Accounting in relevant projects and initiatives.
  
 As a business partner and trusted advisor, the Chief Accountant provides expert advice on accounting treatment, financial risks, regulatory developments, and legal entity considerations. The role proactively identifies accounting risks, drives compliance, and supports informed decision-making across the organization.
  
 Key Responsibilities
  
  Lead TTI SOT accounting processes and ensure alignment with local and Group accounting principles
 Own and drive the closing process, ensuring timely, high-quality monthly, quarterly and annual financial closes
 Lead financial analysis, balance sheet reviews, and reconciliations to ensure financial integrity, accuracy and compliance. 
 Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and reporting standards, including RFR2 and IFRS, and oversee statutory and other compliance reporting
 Own the annual report process for Volvo Parts AB and act as the main point of contact for external auditors
 Representing FCA in relevant projects, initiatives and decision-making forums, contributing with accounting and financial expertise and helping set priorities
 Drive continuous improvement, standardization and efficiency in accounting and financial reporting processes
     Profile description:
Who are you?
You are an experienced accounting professional who combines strong technical knowledge with energy to drive financial priorities in a dynamic environment. You are comfortable with leading and coordinating work across functions, locations, and cultures. You communicate clearly, act with integrity, and engage stakeholders to make progress toward shared goals.
You have an analytical and well-organized approach, and you proactively improve processes while maintaining a strong focus on quality and compliance.
Qualifications
5 years of relevant accounting experience in a large company or group environment
Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end accounting processes, financial reporting, internal controls and legal entity governance.
Proactive mindset, with the drive to take ownership and improve ways of working
Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions
Full professional proficiency in written and spoken Swedish and English
Experience working with shared service centers or outsourced processes is an advantage
Ready for the next move?
This position is based in Gothenburg, Sweden and requires occasional travel.
 
Last application date: December 2, 2026. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted continuously, so don’t wait!
 
In selecting candidates, we look for a match with our team’s culture, experience, and mindset. The ideal candidate brings both a winning attitude and the ability to deliver results.
 
As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

Do you want to be part of an interesting growth journey?
Hedin Mobility Group is an exciting workplace consisting of a bunch of wonderful and talented people. If you appreciate a varied everyday life and prefer to work in a changing environment, you will thrive here.
 Our employees are the foundation of Hedin Mobility Group's successful growth for many years. There are many development opportunities in the Group and we want individuals with the right potential to have the opportunity to grow with us!

Hedin Business Center is looking for a Business Controller
Hedin Business Center provides professional and devoted support to our Import Operations including Hedin US Motor, the exclusive importer and distributor of the Ford F-150 in Europe - Hedin Adventure Car - the official distributor of INEOS Grenadier across 11 markets in Europe, Hedin Premium Car - the importer of the prestigious brand Hongqi in 6 markets in Europe and Hedin Distribution AG/SK/CZ - the official distributor of XPENG in Switzerland, Slovakia and Czech Republic.
 Who are we looking for?
We are now looking for a Business Controller to further accelerate our operations across Europe. You will play a critical role in supporting the financial health and strategic decision-making of the various brands within our portfolio. Furthermore, you will be responsible for analyzing financial data, monitoring performance, and providing insights to improve profitability and cost efficiency. You will be welcomed by a positive team in a forward-thinking and fast-growing company. The position will be located in our attractive new office space in Mölndal and you will report to our CFO & Head of Business Center.
You have a Masters degree in economics, accounting, engineering or equivalent and several (5+) years of work experience in controlling, financial analysis or similar roles. To thrive in the role as Business Controller, it is important that you are comfortable with ownership and responsibility. You are structured, analytical and always deliver timely and accurately. Furthermore, you are a team player who is also used to work independently. We believe you are an outgoing person who finds it both exciting and stimulating to meet new people, have fun at work and enjoy working in an ever-changing environment with high demands.

Your key areas of responsibility:

Business Performance Monitoring: Track and analyze business performance by evaluating financial data and key business metrics, ensuring that targets are met.

Financial Planning and Analysis: Prepare and manage annual Budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial planning. Analyze Budget deviations and provide actionable insights to improve financial outcomes.

Reporting: Deliver regular financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, cash flow reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs), ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

Cost Control: Monitor and evaluate operational expenses, identify areas for cost reduction, and recommend measures to enhance profitability.

Stakeholder Collaboration:

Support commercial decision-making through pricing analysis, campaign evaluation, and margin optimization

Support market initiatives, including business case development and performance tracking for new initiatives and channels

Process Improvement: Identify and implement improvements to financial processes, controls, and reporting systems to drive efficiency and enhance data integrity.

Furthermore, you have:

Strong commercial acumen with the ability to drive profitability through pricing strategies, margin analysis, campaign follow-up, and business case evaluation across multiple brands or product lines.

Understanding of end-to-end value chains, including procurement, logistics, inventory management, and dealer/distribution networks, with the ability to identify risks and optimization opportunities.

Demonstrated ability to act as a strategic partner to senior stakeholders, influencing decision-making through data-driven insights and challenging the business constructively.

Advanced analytical capabilities and strong experience working with ERP and BI tools (e.g. SAP, Business Central, Power BI), with a focus on automation, data quality, and scalable reporting.

Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English.

Experience in the automotive industry is a plus.

Why work with us
As an employer, we are good at taking advantage of driven and committed employees. With us, there are many career paths to choose from – our attitude is that individuals with the right potential should be able to grow with us. We are responsible and ensure fair terms of employment, and all operations are covered by collective agreements. We care about our employees and see a long-term and sustainable working life as a strong competitive advantage. We offer a wide range of benefits such as advance vacation, extra parents' salary and a generous wellness allowance to protect our employees' health. Read more on our website www.hedinmobilitygroup.com

Sales Support Representative
Hönö | Berg Propulsion

Since 1912, Berg Propulsion has been developing technology that drives the global maritime industry forward. From our origins as a Swedish shipyard, we have grown into an international leader in marine propulsion systems, delivering propellers, thrusters, control systems, and hybrid-electric solutions to customers around the world.
At our headquarters in Hönö, you'll find a very collaborative and welcoming work environment with short decision-making paths, high engagement, and a strong team spirit! Here, cutting-edge technology is combined with the genuine Berg culture—where collaboration, accountability, and continuous development are at the heart of everything we do.

Are you our next Sales Support Representative?
We are currently looking for a new colleague to join our Sales Support team. This is a fixed-term position with the possibility of a permanent contract after the first six months.
As part of our team, you will play a key role in supporting the operational backbone of our aftermarket business. This position is ideal if you enjoy coordinating multiple tasks, thrive in a structured environment, and are energized by collaborating with others to ensure a smooth and efficient order process.
We are a highly skilled and committed team who is known for its positive attitude and strong sense of collaboration. We support one another, share knowledge, and work together to find solutions—even when the pace is high!

The Role
As a Sales Support Representative, you will be responsible for ensuring that customer orders are handled efficiently and with a high level of quality—from handover by the Sales team through delivery and invoicing.
You will act as a central point of coordination between several internal departments, ensuring that accurate information is maintained in our systems, deliveries are monitored, and any deviations are managed in a structured manner. The role is primarily an internal support function with many cross-functional contacts throughout the organization.
We are also in an exciting phase of development, implementing new ways of working and improving our processes. Therefore, we are looking for someone who enjoys contributing ideas and sees continuous improvement as a natural part of everyday work.

Key Responsabilities
In this role, you will be responsible for:

Ensuring an efficient order flow from handover through delivery and invoicing.

Registering and administering customer orders in the ERP system.

Managing price adjustments and updating item master data.

Monitoring deliveries and handling deviations.

Coordinating daily activities with Production, Purchasing, Logistics, and other internal departments.

Managing returns and warranty claims.

Ensuring that information and documentation in our systems is accurate and up to date.

You will have the authority to prioritize and reschedule orders, manage price updates, determine lead times in collaboration with the business, and independently handle standardized warranty and claims processes.

QualificationsRequired
Upper secondary school diploma or equivalent.

Preferred
Post-secondary education in Engineering, Logistics, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.

Experience & SkillsWe believe you have:
Experience in Sales Support, After Sales, Order Management, or a similar coordination role.

Experience working with ERP systems and other business administration systems.

Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, spoken and written. 

Preferred
Experience working in a B2B environment.

Knowledge of spare parts, service processes, or technical products. 

Personal Qualities
We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and believe you recognize yourself in the following:

Communicative – You build strong relationships, communicate clearly, and establish trust.

Structured and Detail-Oriented – You work methodically, stay organized, and maintain a high level of quality.

Service-Minded – You naturally enjoy supporting others and delivering excellent service.

Solution-Oriented – You focus on opportunities and find effective solutions to challenges.

Responsible and Proactive – You take ownership of your work, drive tasks forward, and actively contribute to improvements.

Why join Berg Propulsion?
At Berg Propulsion, you'll become part of a company where people enjoy their work and have the opportunity to grow. We offer a workplace by the sea, short decision-making paths, and a culture built on collaboration, support, and shared success.
You will have a manager who leads with trust, encourages initiative, and supports your professional development as you grow in your role.
To give you the best possible start, we provide a well-structured onboarding program. You will begin by learning about our products in our production environment before gradually being introduced to our systems, processes, and ways of working.

We look forward to receiving your application!
We will review all applications and contact selected candidates as soon as the recruitment process resumes.
Thank you for your patience and we look forward reading your application!

Production Line Manager - Night Shift

About the role
At Aimpoint, quality and safety always come first. We are now looking for Production Line Managers to strengthen our production organization in Malmö.
This is a permanent night-shift leadership role where you will be responsible for leading a team of approximately 50-60 operators and Shift Leaders in a manufacturing environment that combines manual assembly with automated production processes. You will spend most of your time on the production floor, close to both employees and products, ensuring that daily production runs according to plan while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and performance.

As a Production Line Manager, you will be responsible for daily operations during your shift, leading and developing your team, resolving operational challenges, and driving improvements together with employees and key stakeholders across the organization.

You will play an important role in creating a safe, engaging, and high-performing work environment while contributing to Aimpoint's continued growth and operational excellence.

In this role, you will:

Lead, coach, and develop operators and Shift Leaders in daily production activities.

Ensure production targets, quality standards, and safety requirements are met.

Allocate resources, prioritize work, and manage operational deviations.

Drive continuous improvements and support Lean-based ways of working.

Promote a safe, engaged, and high-performing work environment.

Collaborate closely with Production Engineering, Quality, Planning, Supply Chain, and other key functions.

Support employee development through feedback, onboarding, and performance follow-up.

Have the authority to stop production whenever quality or safety standards are at risk.

Required Qualifications

Experience leading or coordinating work in a manufacturing environment.

Experience in assembly-based manufacturing with an understanding of both manual and automated production processes.

Experience working with quality, standardized work methods, and deviation management.

Experience with health and safety activities and continuous improvement initiatives.

Willingness and ability to work permanent night shifts.

Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

Good computer skills and experience with business systems and Microsoft Office.

Meriting Qualifications

Experience with direct people management in production environments.

Experience leading through Shift Leaders or Coordinators.

Experience from high-volume manufacturing with high quality requirements.

Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.

Experience from automated production environments.

Familiarity with ISO 9001 and ISO 45001 standards.

Technical education and/or formal leadership training.

To succeed in this role
You are an engaged and energetic leader who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. You enjoy being present on the production floor and are comfortable making decisions when quality, safety, or delivery performance is at stake.
As a leader, you are clear, structured, and approachable. You create trust through your presence and communication, and you foster an environment where employees feel comfortable raising ideas, concerns, and improvement suggestions.
You are comfortable handling multiple priorities simultaneously and have the ability to remain calm and focused when challenges arise. Most importantly, you are a team player who enjoys developing people and achieving results together.

Working Hours This is a permanent night-shift position. You will lead the night-shift production team and be responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality operations throughout the shift.

Compensation & Benefits
The position offers a base salary in the range of SEK 40,000-45,000 per month, depending on experience and qualifications. In addition to the base salary, shift allowances and compensation for unsocial working hours are provided in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

Why Aimpoint?
We are driven by our core values: Performance, Innovation, and Commitment! - and we believe you are too!
Just like us, you enjoy having fun at work and find interaction with others both challenging and rewarding. Collaboration with colleagues and customers is a natural part of the job.

You can apply quickly and easily through our career page.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

SAVR is a fast-growing Swedish fintech company on a mission to reinvent investing. We empower investors with a platform that offers lower fees, greater transparency, and a radically improved experience.
We’re not just building another investment service — we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.
The Role
As a Senior Platform & Backend Engineer at SAVR, you’ll work across cloud infrastructure and backend development with security embedded in everything you build.
You’ll help evolve the cloud platform our services run on while contributing directly to backend services and integrations. From improving deployment pipelines and strengthening access controls to building new functionality, you’ll work across the systems that power our investment platform.
You’ll collaborate closely with our engineering teams to make our platform more reliable, secure and efficient and make it easier for developers to build, deploy and operate their services.
Our infrastructure is built on AWS and managed through Terraform, with CI/CD powered by GitHub Actions. Our backend services are built in Kotlin, PHP/Laravel and Python and run on ECS, with data in Aurora, PostgreSQL and Snowflake.
Your Mission
Build and evolve our cloud platform. Improve our AWS infrastructure, networking, deployment pipelines and operational tooling through Terraform and automation.

Develop backend services and integrations. Design, build and maintain reliable software, working closely with other engineers on functionality and architectural improvements.

Strengthen security across infrastructure and applications. Improve access controls, secrets management, vulnerability scanning and secure CI/CD practices, making security a natural part of how we develop and operate our systems.

Improve reliability and observability. Develop monitoring, logging and alerting, troubleshoot production issues and address their root causes.

Make development smoother. Reduce manual work and improve the tools and workflows that help our engineering teams build, deploy and run services confidently.

Balance performance, scalability and cost. Make thoughtful technical decisions that meet today’s needs while supporting future growth.

Share knowledge and raise engineering standards. Contribute through code reviews, infrastructure reviews and constructive feedback across the team.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You…
Have 5+ years of professional engineering experience, with hands-on experience across cloud infrastructure and backend development in production environments.

Have strong experience with AWS and Terraform, alongside CI/CD, Docker and container orchestration such as ECS or EKS.

Understand how applications, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure fit together, and enjoy troubleshooting across those layers.

Have practical experience securing cloud environments and services through approaches such as least-privilege IAM, secrets management, vulnerability management and secure API design.

Care about automation, observability and building systems that are reliable and maintainable.

Enjoy taking ownership, collaborating across disciplines and balancing delivery with long-term improvements.

Communicate fluently in English and value sharing knowledge and giving and receiving feedback.

You must also hold Swedish citizenship or a valid EU work permit, as visa sponsorship is unfortunately not available for this role.

🧠 Open-minded – we embrace new ideas, diverse perspectives, and continuous learning

At Husqvarna Group, innovation is in our DNA. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. We develop next-generation handheld products where performance, usability, and environmental responsibility are key. At the heart of these products is the powertrain—and that’s where you come in.

Join our Base Engine team in Power Systems
We are now looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join the Base Engine group within Power Systems, part of Handheld R&D. Power Systems is responsible for developing the powertrains in our products. In this team we focus on petrol-powered handheld products, developing engines and engine components for our 2-stroke engines, including cylinder, piston, crankshaft and bearings.
Base Engine is a team of around 11 design engineers, some with specialist areas, who work together to develop the next generation of handheld products for forestry and urban environments. We work with the full life cycle of a component, from the first idea to product care.

About the role:

Develop and design components for new products, for example a new chainsaw, and make sure they fit in the whole product and meet new product requirements
Create 2D and 3D drawings and manage design changes, including tooling changes
Carry out root cause analyses to understand why failures occur in complex systems
Participate in regular sync meetings with your platform lead, for example to discuss changes of supplier for a component
Work closely with neighbouring design engineers, test and verification, manufacturing and suppliers

In our different product value streams you work together with a platform lead and look at the product as a whole, not only at the component level. This is a cross-functional role with many internal contact points, and you will need to manage several tasks in parallel. You will have support from experienced colleagues, and we encourage you to ask for help when you need it.

You’re proactive, curious and take great ownership of your components. You enjoy digging into technical details and complex systems. Experience with CAD tools such as CATIA V5 and PLM (e.g. Teamcenter)

jobs.occupation: Associate researcher in Experimental lung transplantation
jobs.description:
Description of workplaceThe research group is led by Associated professor Sandra Lindstedt and has a long-standing interest in research related to lung transplantation, post-transplant complications, and lung regeneration. The group focuses on developing novel therapeutic strategies to treat lung injury, improve donor organ quality, and reduce complications following lung transplantation. A particular focus is on acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), primary graft dysfunction (PGD), and regenerative approaches to lung repair.
We offerLund University is a governmental authority, which means you get special benefits, generous holidays, and a favorable occupational pension. Read more on the university's website about being employed at Lund University, Work at Lund University
Work descriptionA associate researcher position is available within the Lindstedt research group, focusing on translational research in lung transplantation, lung injury, and regenerative medicine. The duties at the research unit primarily consist of experimental and laboratory-based research, with a particular focus on the development and evaluation of novel therapeutic strategies to improve lung repair and transplantation outcomes.
The main responsibilities include:
independently designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting research projects, as well as collecting, analyzing, interpreting, and managing experimental data.
The work involves the development and optimization of experimental protocols, evaluation of therapeutic interventions, and application of cellular, molecular, ultra-high-plexed immunofluorescence and histological techniques to investigate mechanisms of lung injury, repair, and regeneration.
The position also includes responsibility for preparing high-quality scientific manuscripts for publication in international peer-reviewed journals, contributing to research grant applications, and presenting research findings at national and international scientific conferences.
The majority of the work will be conducted independently, while also involving close collaboration with internal and external research partners and clinical collaborators.
In addition, the position includes mentorship and supervision of doctoral students, Bachelor’s and Master’s students, and other junior researchers, as well as contributing to the coordination and development of ongoing research activities within the group.

Other work tasks might also be included.
QualificationsRequired qualifications
PhD (or equivalent) in biomedical sciences, biotechnology, molecular biology, regenerative medicine, or a related field.
A minimum of four years of documented research experience following completion of the PhD, demonstrating scientific independence and responsibility.
Documented experience in experimental and translational biomedical research, particularly within cell therapies, lung injury, lung transplantation, or regenerative medicine.
Hands-on experience with small and large-animal models and/or ex vivo organ perfusion.
Experience with standard cellular and molecular biology techniques, including cell culture, ELISA, Western blotting, qPCR, immunohistochemistry and high-plexed immunofluorescence.
Demonstrated ability to independently design, plan, coordinate, and conduct complex experimental research projects.
Documented scientific productivity through publications in international peer-reviewed journals.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Independent and responsible, with the ability to organize and manage research activities and take responsibility for scientific quality and project progress.
Collaborative, with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary research environments.
Analytical and solution-oriented, with the ability to critically evaluate experimental results and address complex scientific challenges.

Meritorious qualifications:
Additional specialized training in experimental transplantation, regenerative medicine, cell therapy, or related disciplines.
Relevant training and certification in laboratory animal science, particularly involving large- and small-animal experimental models.
Completed courses in higher education teaching and pedagogy.
Experience with experimental lung transplantation, including large- and small-animal models of lung injury and transplantation.
Hands-on experience with ex vivo lung perfusion (EVLP) and human ex vivo lung models, including precision-cut lung slices (PCLS).
Experience in the development and evaluation of cell-based and regenerative therapies, particularly mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) and mitochondrial therapeutics.
Experience with cellular, molecular, histological, and proteomic analyses, including the handling and processing of human and animal tissue samples.
Experience in managing and coordinating interdisciplinary research projects and national or international collaborations.
Documented experience in scientific supervision, preparation of research grant applications, and dissemination of research findings through publications and international conferences.

Other information
The position is a fixed-term employment according to the Special Fixed-term Employment (SÄVA) regulations §5 p1 LAS, and it is full-time. The desired start date is 2027-01-01 or as agreed upon, with an end date of 2027-12-31.
How to Apply
Applications are to be submitted via the University’s recruitment system. The application should include a CV and a personal letter justifying your interest in the position and how it matches your qualifications. The application should also include a degree certificate or equivalent and any other document to which you would like to draw attention (copies of grade transcripts, details of referees, letters of recommendation, etc.).

Company Description

Bosch Home Comfort in Tranås develops, manufactures and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources: rock, water and air. Our Tranås site brings together manufacturing, research and development, and business functions, creating an environment where ideas and decisions are closely connected to our products and operations.
We believe in technology that makes a difference: Invented for life.
 

Job Description

Your contribution to something big
Do you enjoy understanding what really drives performance in a manufacturing business, rather than simply reporting the numbers?
As our Plant Controller, you will work at the intersection of finance and manufacturing, partnering closely with Plant Management and colleagues across production, logistics, engineering and other functions.
You will turn financial and operational data into insights that support better decisions, stronger performance and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on controlling role where you can build a broad understanding of our manufacturing operation and have a real impact on how we manage costs, investments and performance.
Your key responsibilities
Business partnering: Act as a financial partner to Plant Management and cost center owners. Provide analysis, challenge assumptions and translate financial performance into clear insights and actions.
Planning & forecasting: Drive key parts of our business planning, budgeting and forecasting processes, including cost centers, Capex, production volumes, headcount and product costs.
Manufacturing performance: Analyze manufacturing costs, productivity and operational deviations. Work with the organization to understand root causes and identify appropriate countermeasures.
Product costing: Lead Planned Product Cost (PPC) calculations, follow Actual Product Costs (APC) and analyze the operational and financial drivers behind deviations.
Investments, assets & inventory: Support investment planning and follow-up, fixed asset management, inventory valuation, physical stocktaking and continuous inventory control.
Reporting & continuous improvement: Drive monthly and annual plant performance reporting while continuously improving our processes, reporting, dashboards and use of SAP and other digital tools.

Qualifications

What distinguishes you
You have a degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a comparable field, together with experience in controlling, financial analysis or a related finance role.
Experience from manufacturing or another industrial environment is particularly valuable.
We are looking for someone with:
Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial and operational data
Experience with budgeting, forecasting, cost accounting or operational reporting
Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel
Experience working with ERP systems. SAP experience, particularly within controlling or manufacturing processes, is an advantage
Professional working proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is an advantage, but not a requirement

Experience with product costing, Power BI, automation or other data-analysis tools is an advantage, but you do not need to tick every box. We value your ability to learn, understand the business and turn data into meaningful insights.
Who you are
You are curious about the business behind the numbers. When you see a deviation, your instinct is not simply to report it. You want to understand why it happened, what is driving it and what we can do about it.
You are comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions and collaborating across functions to find solutions. You can explain financial concepts clearly to colleagues outside Finance and combine strong analytical thinking with a practical mindset.
You take ownership of your work, build strong relationships and are motivated by understanding how a manufacturing business works and how Finance can help make it better.

Additional Information

Why join us in Tranås?
In Tranås, more than 600 associates work across manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a more sustainable future.
For a Plant Controller, this creates an exciting environment where you can see the connection between the numbers, the decisions and what actually happens in the factory.
The role gives you broad exposure to manufacturing finance, product costing, investments and operational performance, while working within the international Bosch organization. It is an opportunity to deepen your controlling expertise, influence the business and continue developing your career.
At Bosch, we value openness, trust and different perspectives, and we want our associates to have opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.

Flexible working hours and hybrid working possibilities where compatible with the role
Employee discounts on Bosch products
Development opportunities within an international Bosch organization

Regular presence at our Tranås site is an important part of the role because of the close collaboration with our manufacturing organization.
